description: This file defines a utility function `getPlayStream` for fetching a playback stream URL (DASH or HLS) from a mock API backend. It constructs the API URL based on environment variables, performs a fetch request, handles errors, and returns an object with the stream URL, type, and raw data.

methods.name: getPlayStream({ signal, type } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a sample playback stream URL from the mock backend, optionally accepting query parameters like 'type'. Handles environment-based URL base selection, performs a fetch request, error handling, and returns structured stream info.
